from confluent_kafka.admin import AdminClient, NewTopic, NewPartitions, ConfigResource, ResourceType

def sync(admin: AdminClient, customers):
    md = admin.list_topics(timeout=30)
    new = []
    for c in customers:                       # c.id, c.partitions, c.retention_ms
        name = f"cust-{c.id}-events"
        if name not in md.topics:
            new.append(NewTopic(name, num_partitions=c.partitions, replication_factor=3,

        if len(md.topics[name].partitions) != c.partitions:

        res = ConfigResource(ResourceType.TOPIC, name)

        admin.alter_configs([res])
    if new:
